correctness.rationale: The exact copula density is nonnegative on the entire stated domain (alpha>0, beta<=1/alpha) and NQD is strict for positive beta. Both opposite population xi integrals are derived with correct conditioning and normalization. Two independent Taylor expansions with exact power integrals give D2 and D3; D2 has unique positive zero 9/2, D3(9/2)=-1458/1595 and D2 prime=-9/100. Analytic extension of Delta/beta^2 and the IFT yield the unique LOCAL curve and signed sides with exact slope -3240/319. The standalone checker at its actual package path passed exact symbolic rational identities and high precision numerical consistency. The domain and local (not global) limits are explicit.

value.rationale: Directed predictability is a natural invariant for deliberately asymmetric copula models; an entire strictly NQD parametric family exhibits opposite directed rankings arbitrarily close to independence, with an exact sharp critical exponent 9/2 and a nontrivial first-order critical-curve displacement. These are structural parameter boundaries motivated by dependence interpretation, not arbitrary numerical cutoffs or restatements of the family definition.
